answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via Verifiable Delay Functions bound to a randomness beacon. Each saffron epoch, the beacon emits an unpredictable seed that an agent hashes with its public key and the prior ember digest to compute sequential modular squarings. Because steps cannot parallelize, attackers must dedicate one fast core and power per fake identity in that window. However, custom ASICs can outrun commodity CPUs to finish multiple proofs in time.
